data.creator_notes:
UPDATE 06/Nov/24 - Since Chub decided to purge all NSFL content from searches on the mobile version, including vore (for some reason), the tag has been removed. Vore, however, still remains a very present feature.

If you've ever played Loneclaw's vore-themed dating sim "It's a Gluttonous Life", then Sigrid is going to be a very familiar sight. Since nobody out there seems to have written up a character based on her (on Chub, at least), I figured "Alright, I guess I'll do it myself then". That being said, while this version of Sigrid is not written with vore as a focus, it is still very much an option so don't say I didn't warn you. Otherwise, feel free to enjoy. Art on this profile was generated by myself.

I also took the liberty of writing some alternate greetings, most of which are set up as sort-of continuations of the first greeting, listed as follows:

1 - New to the city, you head out to a bar to try and meet some new people when Sigrid catches your attention and offers you a drink.

2 - After talking with Sigrid at a bar for a little while, she invites you back to her place for cocktails and then some.

3 - While in the park, you think about a cute giraffe girl you met at a bar the other night. You and her spot one another as she jogs through the park. Recognising you, she decides to stop for a friendly chat.

4 - You head to the beach and cross paths with the giraffe you met the other day, who asks for some help putting on some lotion...and all that implies.
